messages:
Aisha (CS): Quick heads-up 1x: we need a tightened QBR deck for Northridge next Thurs. Core asks: final account health, onboarding exceptions, 3 renewal mitigations, and a short enablement demo. Pls see draft: https://redwood.slides/northridge-draft
Marco (AM): Noted. Two renewal signals to call out: usage drop in feature-X over last 10 days, and pending PO approval. I'll write the commercial ask. Who owns the lead talking point?
Jin (Onboarding): Onboarding: 81% seats active. Three accounts failing verification step; tickets open. Pulling exact ticket IDs now.
Laura - Enablement: I can prep a 3-slide enablement block + 2-min exec talking points. Recommend we surface a customer success story on slide 4.
Samir - Solutions: I'll produce a compact fallback demo (no live API) and a short runbook if integrations are flaky. Can do by Wed EOD.
Marco (AM): Also propose an explicit decision window: Sales exec to confirm billing remediation plan by Fri COB; otherwise mark renewal as at-risk. Thoughts? :straight_ruler:
Aisha (CS): Agree. Marco, put the wording in plain language so execs can approve quickly. Jin 1x: list the three trouble accounts and status. Laura: add the decision window as a callout on slide 2.
Jin (Onboarding): Accounts & tickets:
- northridge-pro 7: webhook cert failure (TKT-4592)
- harborline-enterprise: SAML handshake failing (TKT-4601)
- meridian-svc: env mapping mismatch (TKT-4599)
Escalating TKT-4592 to infra now.
cs-bot: Reminder: QBR checklist missing items -> [health slide, onboarding exceptions, renewals ask, demo fallback]. Due Thu 17:00 PT.
Laura - Enablement: Draft ask copy (suggestion): "Request approval for billing remediation steps and a 7-day adoption sprint. Desired outcome: signed renewal or formal at-risk flag." Pasted note for slide: `Slide 2 - Exec ask: Billing remediation + 7-day adoption sprint (owner: Marco)`
Samir - Solutions: Fallback demo sketch:
```
- Primary: live account walkthrough (10m)
- Fallback: sandbox replay + short recorded clip of integration (3m)
- Fallback owner: Samir
```
I'll add the troubleshooting checklist for webhook certs to the shared doc.
Marco (AM): I'll sync with Sales leadership and include the decision window language. Also adding an item to request legal to prioritize billing amendment for Northridge.
Aisha (CS): Action items (I'll put into Asana):
1) Marco 7: Draft Sales exec ask + decision window (due Fri COB)
2) Laura 7: Enablement slides + 2-min exec talking points (due Wed EOD)
3) Jin 7: Escalate tickets + final onboarding counts (due Wed noon)
4) Samir 7: Demo fallback + troubleshooting checklist (due Wed EOD)
5) CS Ops (Aisha) 7: Finalize health slide + circulate deck for review (due Thu 09:00)
Laura - Enablement: Scheduling a dry-run Thurs 08:30 PT. Invite sent to Aisha, Marco, Samir. Please accept.
Jin (Onboarding): Escalation note posted for TKT-4592. Will update counts by Wed 11:00.
Samir - Solutions: Uploading demo assets to shared folder: https://redwood.docs/demos/northridge-fallback. I'll be on the dry-run.
Aisha (CS): Great. I'll lock the slide order tonight and drop the deck into the review channel tomorrow morning. Keep any late edits on this thread. :thumbsup:
Marco (AM): Thanks all. Will ping once Sales confirms decision window.
cs-bot: Task status: 2/5 items completed (dry-run scheduled, demo assets uploaded). Remaining: Sales ask, onboarding final counts, health slide.
Aisha (CS): Final note 7: If Sales can't commit to the decision window, we escalate to RevOps and tag as at-risk in the renewal tracker.
